cohort: 297 women with vaginismus who were effectively treated
finding: Treatment of vaginismus allows for successful pregnancy and delivery, with cesarean delivery rates comparable to the general population and no increased risk of vaginismus recurrence.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery rates in women with treated vaginismus are similar to the general population, and vaginal delivery appears safe with no increased perineal morbidity or vaginismus recurrence.
birth_weight: Recorded but not reported in the abstract
